notes: τε … καί is split under rule 70 because the ASV writes two English conjunctions ('and … and').
'upon them' rides with the dative αὐτοῖς under rule 106's dative arm, the ASV having written 'laid' as the compound verb's own English word.
The supplied 'his' before 'hands' is a rule 7 helper on the anarthrous χεῖρας; Παύλου is already spent on 'Paul' and is unavailable under rule 76.
